rows.title: Underwritten public offering of 61,540,000 Class A shares (~$200M gross)
rows.detail: Underwriting agreement for 61,540,000 shares of Class A common stock at $3.25 per share; gross proceeds expected ~$200 million before underwriting discounts and expenses; expected to close 10-16-2026 (8-K Item 1.01 / 8.01).
